meta.name: Liquid Pane
meta.notes: Primary and accent are mixed heavily with white into a drifting pastel mesh behind frosted glass; solid primary is used only for CTAs, add buttons, the cart and active filters, and a primary darkened toward the text colour is used for accent type.

issues: Homepage is ~70% empty: every .rv section (featured products, categories, USPs, story, CTA) uses a view()-timeline reveal starting at opacity 0, so in full-page captures/uncommon viewports they never appear — only the non-.rv gallery rail shows, floating alone in a void
The pastel mesh atmosphere stops after the first viewport (fixed canvas + fixed body gradient), leaving a flat grey page below the hero — kills the 'airy pastel atmosphere' art direction
Hero glass panel too tall on desktop: a large dead gap between headline and lead
Orb drag has no affordance: nothing tells the user which surfaces accept the orb until hovering exactly over one
Drag hint is plain grey text, not part of the glass language
Placeholder wells (TQ initials) are acceptable but generic; catalog itself is strong
fixed: Reveal animation is now transform-only (translate + scale), so content is never invisible regardless of timeline support or capture method
Replaced fixed body gradients on both pages with a scroll-attached 1800px repeating pastel mesh tile built from primary/accent tints, so the atmosphere runs the full page length for any brand
Tightened hero min-height (80vh/780 → 72vh/700) to remove the dead gap
While the orb is dragged, all product slabs become breathing glass drop zones (rim glow + halo on the add button); the hovered target still lifts to scale 1.04
Drag hint is now a frosted glass pill matching the UI system
